raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- Stamp shard-list samples with the "Webdataset" restore key kind expected by the DatasetSampler, so `restore_sample` works for JSONL shard directories.
- Prefer tar shards over JSONL files when preparing a fresh directory, so WebDatasets with JSONL side files keep preparing as before.
- Check JSONL index freshness by size only; copies and uploads do not preserve modification times.
- Take shard counts from the manifest and validate each shard index lazily when the shard is first read instead of opening every index at startup.
- Do not report "Done" after a declined re-prepare, and fix the docs example to assign folder-based splits with `--split-parts`.

nodes.body:
Given that folders with jsonl shards now allow for shard paths like `train/1.jsonl`, this means we can have shards that contain `/`.
However here:
https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-Energon/blob/c68b11028dc170c8ee41734da6e7a218dd0d9659/src/megatron/energon/flavors/common/manifest/io.py#L83

The `/` is used as a way to determine which exclusions are sample-level, so excluding a json shard would raise an error "Prepared JSONL shard datasets do not support sample-level excludes"
I would remove the details about what factory is created internally.

Move these details to the section "Dataset Format on Disk for JSONL Datasets".
And place a link here.

This replaces an existing dataset.yaml even if the user explicitly asks not to with `--skip-dataset-yaml`
when re-preparing
This also happens when just rebuilding the index
I believe the typical use-case is rather having the shards flat (like it was before). Should we show both cases?

issue_comments.body:
Given that folders with jsonl shards now allow for shard paths like `train/1.jsonl`, this means we can have shards that contain `/`.
However here:
https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-Energon/blob/c68b11028dc170c8ee41734da6e7a218dd0d9659/src/megatron/energon/flavors/common/manifest/io.py#L83

The `/` is used as a way to determine which exclusions are sample-level, so excluding a json shard would raise an error "Prepared JSONL shard datasets do not support sample-level excludes"
